summary: 100 ft Aermotor tower in Itawamba County, MS, listed by NHLR in June 2022; current condition not confirmed; no build date, staffing or fire history found.

events.note: Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register June 26, 2022 as US 1621, MS 14; nominated by Jason Johns

evidence.supports: Register describes a 100ft Aermotor; its only visit note says the base could not be reached
evidence.quote: 100ft Aermotor. Unable to reach the base due to muddy conditions.

evidence.supports: Site is in Itawamba County, Mississippi
Build date is listed as unknown
Administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission
Forest Lookouts places Hopewell in Itawamba County
Aermotor towers were made of galvanized steel
evidence.quote: Aermotor towers were made of galvanized steel

sources.title: The Aermotor Company: From Windmills to Forest Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR entry, the Forest Lookouts index (name and county only) and the Aermotor history were usable. Two WebSearch queries and several page reads turned up no local history, staffing, fire, build or fate information. The register's Hopewell visit note is undated. Status is 'listed' only: the register's present-tense description is not a dated check, so the story says the current condition is not confirmed. height_m is converted from the register's 100 ft. No access key set because the sources give no access level. No photos found.
